headline: RBA holds cash rate at 4.35% but flags inflation still 'too high' and further hikes possible
summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia's Monetary Policy Board unanimously kept the cash rate at 4.35% on 11 August 2026, extending the pause it began in June, while warning that a further increase remains possible if inflation risks materialise. For SDRs selling to lenders and insurers, this prolonged rate uncertainty keeps pressure on customer contact volumes (hardship calls, repricing queries) and complicates CX planning for financial services accounts.

headline: Finder research: 55% of Australian mortgage holders report stress, spending 38% of income on repayments
summary: A Finder survey of about 1,000 Australians (291 current mortgage borrowers), published 11 August 2026, found 55% of mortgage holders experience mortgage stress and devote an average of 38% of after-tax income to repayments, with many spending over half their take-home pay on their home loan. This is a direct pain-point signal for banks and lenders in the lower mid-market segment: rising hardship queries and dissatisfaction with lender communication are exactly the kind of friction experience management programs are built to surface and reduce (single source).

headline: NICE runs CXone 26.3 release briefing webinars, ANZ session follows
summary: NICE held AMER/EMEA briefing webinars on 11 August 2026 walking customers through new features in the CXone 26.3 release cycle (running August 3 to October 25, 2026), with a dedicated ANZ-region session scheduled the next day. This shows NICE actively re-engaging its ANZ CXone contact-centre base with new capabilities, useful context for reps prospecting accounts that may be currently locked into or evaluating NICE (single source).

headline: AFCA publishes new rulebook covering general insurance claims handling standards
summary: On 10 August 2026 the Australian Financial Complaints Authority published three new Approach papers: a standalone paper on general insurance claims handling, an updated paper on non-financial loss, and a new paper on uninsured motorist complaints, giving insurers a documented benchmark for when claims conduct falls short. This directly touches complaints-handling and CX processes at general insurers, a clear opening to discuss how experience management can help firms track and close claims-handling gaps before they escalate to AFCA (single source).

headline: ASIC reports 150 enforcement actions in FY25/26, with insurance claims handling named a top priority
summary: Coverage published 10 August 2026 detailed ASIC's FY2025/26 enforcement record: 150 enforcement actions, 114 individuals/businesses removed or restricted from providing financial or credit services, and 36 individuals disqualified from managing corporations, with insurance complaints and claims handling, private credit practices and misleading pricing flagged as ongoing 2026 priorities. For SDRs, this signals continued regulatory heat on complaints and claims processes at banks, insurers and credit providers in the ANZ lower mid-market (single source).

headline: Genesys pushes new AI contact-centre features live in Genesys Cloud
summary: Genesys shipped new Genesys Cloud capabilities on 10 August 2026, including system-detected forecast outliers and live screen monitoring for supervisors, part of its ongoing AI feature cadence. Relevant for SDRs positioning against Genesys in ANZ contact-centre and CX accounts that track vendor release velocity (single source).

headline: NIQ (Nielsen) posts strong Q2 2026 earnings, APAC returns to growth
summary: NIQ Global Intelligence reported Q2 2026 revenue of $1,124.2 million, up 8.0% year-over-year (5.8% organic constant currency), with adjusted EBITDA margins expanding 270bps to 23.3% and APAC returning to positive growth at 1.9% after a weak stretch. Shares jumped over 17% after hours on the fifth straight quarter of guidance beats, underscoring that this insights/market-research competitor is well-capitalized and pushing hard on AI-powered analytics, relevant context when positioning Qualtrics against Nielsen/NIQ-influenced research budgets in ANZ accounts.

headline: AI-native market research startup Echovane raises $1M seed round
summary: Echovane, a San Francisco-based startup used by P&G, Haleon and Kantar, raised a $1 million round co-led by Titan Capital and Neon to expand AI agents that run entire market research studies (design, fielding, participant recruitment, analysis) without traditional panel logistics. It signals a new class of AI-native research automation vendors encroaching on territory traditionally served by experience management and survey platforms.

headline: National auction clearance rate edges up to 50.3% but stays far below last year's pace
summary: The weekend auction report for the week ending 8 August 2026 recorded a national clearance rate of 50.3%, up from 48.4% the prior week but well below the 72.9% recorded in the same week last year; Canberra's clearance rate fell to 36% from 73% a year earlier. Weak, uneven clearance rates point to continued softness in property transaction volumes, which affects demand for mortgage broking, conveyancing and insurance CX programs tied to settlement activity (single source).

headline: Medallia explores new growth funding round amid CX market consolidation
summary: Reports indicate Medallia is in early talks with investors for a new funding round as competition in the customer experience space intensifies. The move follows several smaller CX vendors being acquired over the past year.

headline: Qualtrics names new Chief Revenue Officer to lead global go-to-market
summary: Qualtrics announced a leadership change with a new CRO tasked with accelerating enterprise growth. The appointment signals a renewed push into international markets over the next fiscal year.

headline: New data privacy rules could reshape how CX platforms handle customer feedback
summary: Regulators in the EU proposed stricter consent requirements for survey and feedback data collection. Analysts expect CX platform vendors to accelerate compliance tooling over the coming quarters.

headline: Medallia launches AI-powered sentiment analysis for real-time agent coaching
summary: The new product uses generative AI to flag negative sentiment during live customer calls and suggest coaching prompts to agents. Early customers report faster resolution times in pilot programs.

headline: Qualtrics customers cite integration complexity as top pain point in recent survey
summary: A third-party buyer survey found that nearly 40% of Qualtrics customers struggle with integrating the platform into existing data stacks. The company is reportedly hiring additional solutions engineers to address onboarding friction.
